alert.title: Z.ai Ox Alpha Model’s Secret Run Breaks OpenRouter Records - News Anyway
alert.google_link: captured in original alert row; ordinary GET redirected to consent.google.com

publisher_article.claim: Secondary article attributes ~23 trillion tokens over six days to one model, Ox Alpha, on OpenRouter, describing it as ~2.3× the next closest model launch. It is a model-specific launch-run claim, not a platform-wide aggregate.
publisher_article.chronology_caveat: Article published Oct7 yet also says identity confirmed “last week” while giving Aug26; those dates do not agree. Exact report period endpoints/dataset/method for the 23T figure are not supplied in the accessible body.

official_openrouter_corroboration.page_text: Current official model page says Ox Alpha was Z.ai GLM-5.3-Flash and lists release date Aug20, 2026. It does not confirm the ~23T/six-day record figure in the captured body.

official_zai_check.finding: Search-indexed official Z.ai result described anonymous pre-release Ox Alpha testing, but direct GET returned a 604-byte body with no extractable article text. Treat as an access/body gap, not confirmation of the 23T figure.

freshness_and_scope: Alert arrived Oct19, 12 days after the publisher article and about seven weeks after its reported August run. No new October model-specific or platform-weekly measurement is in this alert. Reuse current chart separately at data/deep_review_20261017/work/light1800_sources.json; its weekly total includes displayed models plus Others and does not measure this August six-day run.
